description.en: The RTOR560R Side Plate (305x536 mm) is designed for rear-mounted torsion spring systems in overhead door applications. Available in both right-hand (RTOR560R) and left-hand (RTOR560L) versions, it forms a key structural component of the spring assembly.The cable pulley is mounted directly to the side plate, ensuring accurate positioning and reliable operation of the lifting system. Manufactured for strength and durability, the side plate provides stable support for the spring hardware and contributes to smooth door operation.
